scope: Both edge layouts close the long r496 slits. B gives the strongest readable rear lock breakup and retains a smaller dark groove and broad sheen.

gains: Both variants remove the long continuous r496 rear and oblique openings.
B preserves more visible separation of rear locks and nape ends than A.
The measured rear width stays at 402 pixels and the exact r495 ear-tuck geometry is preserved.
defects: A smooths most of the distinct lock bodies.
B retains a shorter dark groove and several tapered gaps at the nape.
The hair still has broad sheet-like sheen and regular side ridges. Facial form, skin and other body features were outside this round.

metric.method: Fixed 640x640 images. Dark means luminance less than 65 percent of the median in same-row flanking bands. Rear ROI x348-378 and y330-509 with x316-338 and x385-405 flanks. Rear width uses luminance above 24 in that band. Oblique ROI x307-340 and y335-474 with x280-302 and x346-366 flanks. The strips measure rendered contrast.

crown.scope: All 24,831 strands at control indices 0 through 9. Nearest oriented triangle minus stored radius. Independent rays at the minimum and curve 5535.

limitations: Finite sample spacing between evaluated points
No hair self-contact, clothes or continuous motion

nativeEvaluatedSampleResult.method: Blender Curve to Points in EVALUATED mode, preserving sampled radius and curve ownership
nativeEvaluatedSampleResult.posteriorZoneRule: Absolute X <= 77 mm, Y >= 39 mm, Z in [1.325, 1.516] m in the neutral source frame

rights: Inherited exact source notices. The r484 aligned Angelica profile was inspected. DarkNik and NikZava284 attribution under CC BY 4.0 remains. No reference geometry was imported.

resources.initialPreview: First 6,000 MiB admission test refused before Blender started. Admitted at 5,500 MiB. System commit reserve stopped the renderer at 96.1896 seconds after ten verified frames.
